descriptions.preferred: The large sevento nine-lobed leaves are a bright green, and the lobes are long-ovate with conspicuous deeply toothed margins. The very narrow tip of each lobe gives a distinctive effect. Fall color is unique—a distinct yellow-gold blended with light orange and reds. The bark is a strong green with white streaking and an overtone of bluish gray. This Acer 'KIHACHIJO¯ ' 89 Acer palmatum

sources.title: 黄八丈Acer Palmatum 'Kihachijo'
sources.description: 日系品种，名字来源于位于日本伊豆群岛的八丈岛。春 叶为黄绿色或者嫩绿色，结种率高，夏季返绿，但是新 叶为黄色并有红色的色斑，秋季为橙红色或者黄色。生 长速度中等，可全日照，成年株可达 4 米左右高度。

rhs.description: Small, rounded, shrubby tree to about 6m tall, with distinctive, double-serrated, flat, bright green leaves about 7cm long and 9cm wide, that turn yellow-gold, flushed rose-pink, then light orange and red in autumn. The bark is dark green overlaid with bluish-grey, then white streaking. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, purple fruits

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 大型叶片具 7 至 9 裂，呈鲜绿色；裂片为长卵形，边缘有醒目而深的锯齿。每个裂片极狭的尖端形成鲜明特色。秋色独特，为明显的金黄色，并混合浅橙色与红色。树皮为浓绿色，带白色条纹，并覆有一层蓝灰色调。该品种健壮、耐性好、长势稳健，可发育成圆整的矮乔木或高大灌木，高可达 20 英尺（6 米），在园林中能带来与众不同的观感。其名称意为“来自八丈岛”。后续原文夹杂了 'Kingsville Variegated'、'Kinran'、'Kinshi' 等多个品种的 OCR 混杂内容；可辨识部分包括：'Kingsville Variegated' 为介于 'Kagiri nishiki' 与

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适用于乡村风或自然式花园。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 小型、圆整、灌木状的小乔木，高约 6 米。叶片平展，具显著的重锯齿，鲜绿色，长约 7 厘米、宽约 9 厘米；秋季转为黄金币色，并染玫瑰粉，随后呈浅橙色和红色。树皮深绿色，上覆蓝灰色，之后出现白色条纹。春季开不显眼的红紫色小花，之后可能结带翅的紫色果实。
